APE-Bench I: An Automated Proof Engineering Benchmark
	


  
    
  
    
  
    
  
    


APE-Bench I is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) in the domain of automated proof engineering within the Lean 4 theorem proving environment. This dataset represents the official implementation of the research described in "APE-Bench I: Towards File-level Automated Proof Engineering of Formal Math Libraries".
